name: com.unity.memoryprofiler
description: The Memory Profiler offers a unified solution allowing you to profile both small projects on mobile devices and big AAA projects on high end machines. It provides actionable information about allocations in the engine to allow developers to manage and reduce memory usage.

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Added VisualEffectAsset and VFXManager meta data to the Selected Item Details panel, listing their CPU and GPU buffers, baked texture, indirect command buffers and index buffers with their sizes, for snapshots captured from Unity versions that report it.

### Fixed

- Fixed the search for a selected Unity Object's Editor counterpart, which enables the "Select in Editor" button and the preview in Selected Item Details, failing with a NullReferenceException in Unity versions where a search can finish before the search request returns.
- Fixed the "Show Memory Map view" preference only taking effect after reopening the Memory Profiler window. The Memory Map tab is now added or removed as soon as the preference changes.
- Fixed clicking Capture repeatedly starting overlapping captures that could fail with a NullReferenceException and leave the modal "Memory capture" progress bar stuck, making the Editor unusable. Further clicks while a capture is in progress are now rejected, and the progress bar is always cleared when a capture ends.
- Fixed the Editor becoming unresponsive for minutes when closing the Memory Profiler window while a table or comparison of large snapshots was still being built ([UUM-161145](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/UUM-161145)).
- Fixed setting relative snapshot paths with "../" entries to actually resolve to the right parent folder.
